item.title: Canadian Cooper Gallant skyrockets into top-10 at Elite Series event in Alabama
item.description: SCOTTSBORO — It was moving day for Canadian Cooper Gallant on Friday. Gallant, of Bowmanville, Ont., went from 51st overall to No. 9 after the second day of the Elite Series season-opening event on Lake Guntersville.

item.title: Bodies found in area in Mexico where search is on for 10 missing workers from Canadian mine
item.description: MEXICO CITY (AP) — Mexican authorities on Friday announced the discovery of bodies and remains in the northwestern state of Sinaloa in an area of an ongoing search for 10 missing workers from a Canadian gold and silver mine.

item.title: Actor Michael Keaton honored as Man of the Year by Harvard's Hasty Pudding theater group
item.description: BOSTON (AP) — Actor Michael Keaton jousted with an Oscar statue and made burgers Friday night as he was roasted before receiving the 2026 Man of the Year by Harvard University’s Hasty Pudding Theatricals.

item.title: Canadian midfielder Stephen Eustáquio acquired by LAFC on loan from Porto
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — Canadian national team midfielder Stephen Eustáquio was acquired by Los Angeles FC on loan from Portugal's Porto on Friday through June 30.

item.title: Day-by-day timeline in the search for Savannah Guthrie's missing mother
item.description: Amid the desperate search for 84-year-old Nancy Guthrie, investigators released a detailed timeline from the hours before and after the disappearance of Guthrie, who is the mother of “Today” show host Savannah Guthrie .

item.description: Experts say abductions for ransom are rare, despite the prevalence of dramatic hostage crises on television.

item.title: Los Angeles mayor's race kicks off amid homelessness, raids and fallout from deadly 2025 wildfire
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass is heading into a challenging reelection bid as she continues to suffer fallout from last year’s devastating wildfire and ongoing criticism of City Hall on issues from street paving to homelessness.
